content:
alex: Quick check — retention/gateway milestone for slateboard observability next week. Who's owning the retention config rollout and are there any blockers? cc @jamie @priya
jamie: I can own the rollout for retention gateway. need the final table of views & retention days from support. what's the cutover date?
alex: target is Tue 2026-03-24 EOD for the retention policy flip. that's in the roadmap board (https://redwood.internal/board/slateboard).
priya: noted — main blocker is dashboard query cost. if we reduce default raw retention from 90 -> 30 we need to add rollup views for 30-90 lookbacks. Will need eng-platform help for rollup queries.
matt: PR up for tracing hooks to include new sampling flags — 2623460001. pinging @jamie for review. small change, affects agent sidecar.
matt: branch: feature/trace-sampling-gw
matt: snippet:
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.5
  per_route:
    /api/generate: 1.0
    /stream: 0.1
```
olivia: support needs error-analysis views to be retained 60 days (not 30) for compliance with their audit. Can we special-case error streams?
jamie: we can set an exception for error-* indices and keep 60 days. need list of patterns.
alex: priya/matt — can you two estimate the ops work for rollups + exception config? rough hours pls.
priya: rollups: ~1.5 dev days + 0.5 infra (index templates). need a followup doc.
matt: tracing hooks changes: ~4 hrs dev + 1 hr canary + CI. PR tests failing on windows agent (flaky).
ci-bot: deploy-bot: build passed on feature/trace-sampling-gw, canary scheduled for 2623460800
jamie: ownership: jamie (retention rollout), priya (rollup queries & dashboards), matt (trace hooks & canary), olivia (support requirements & patterns). i'll update the roadmap cards.
alex: thanks. two action items: 1) priya create rollup doc + sample queries 2) matt squash and fix windows test, aim for canary before Tue. i'll send a quick doc to legal about error retention exception.
olivia: I'll gather patterns and legal copies.
priya: I'll drop the rollup doc into the slateboard obs epic and ping reviewers.
matt: fixing tests now, will @alex when ready.
alex: perfect. keep updates in-thread — if anything blocks, call a 15-min sync. :phone:
olivia: ack :thumbsup:
jamie: adding blocker flag on board and assigning tasks. thanks.
